A clean theme for DAG diagrams

Source: R/theme.R
theme_dag.Rd

Based on ggplot2::theme_void() with centered bold title and subtitle.

Usage

theme_dag()

Value

A ggplot2::theme object.

Examples

library(daggr)
theme_dag()
